headlines.title_en: U.S. imposes tariffs of 10%-12.5% on 60 economies
headlines.summary_en: USTR announced on July 23 that it will impose tariffs of 10%-12.5% on dozens of countries and regions under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, citing forced labor, replacing the expiring global import tariff. The new tariffs take effect at 12:01 AM EDT on July 24 (12:00 PM Beijing time). USTR said 60 economies will be subject to the tariffs, covering over 99% of US trade. Senior US officials said tariffs on in-transit goods will take effect at 12:01 AM EDT on July 28 (12:01 PM Beijing time). Imports like fuel, food, and fertilizer are exempt; those subject to separate industry-specific tariffs are excluded.

headlines.title: 中国人民银行今日开展5000亿元MLF操作
headlines.summary: 【中国人民银行今日开展5000亿元MLF操作】7月23日，中国人民银行发布2026年7月份中期借贷便利（MLF）招标公告。公告显示，为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年7月24日，中国人民银行将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展5000亿元MLF操作，期限为1年期。

headlines.title_en: PBOC conducts 500 billion yuan MLF operation today
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC conducts 500 billion yuan MLF operation today] On July 23, the PBOC issued a tender announcement for the July 2026 Medium-term Lending Facility (MLF). To maintain ample liquidity in the banking system, the PBOC will conduct a 500 billion yuan MLF operation on July 24, 2026, with a 1-year term, using fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price award methods.

headlines.title: 证监会召开党的建设暨监管工作座谈会 综合施策全力维护市场平稳运行 提升资本市场韧性
headlines.summary: 【证监会召开党的建设暨监管工作座谈会 综合施策全力维护市场平稳运行 提升资本市场韧性】7月23日，中国证监会召开党的建设暨监管工作座谈会，总结上半年证监会系统党的建设和监管工作，分析当前形势，推动完成全年目标任务。会议认为“市场整体具备较好的配置价值”，并部署了七方面工作，包括综合施策全力维护市场平稳运行、推动中长期资金稳步提升入市规模和比例、加强新型业务监管等。

headlines.title_en: CSRC holds party building and regulatory work symposium, adopts comprehensive measures to maintain stable market operations and enhance capital market resilience
headlines.summary_en: [CSRC holds party building and regulatory work symposium, takes comprehensive measures to maintain market stability, enhance capital market resilience] On July 23, the CSRC held a symposium on party building and regulatory work, summarizing work in the first half of the year, analyzing current conditions, and aiming to complete annual targets. The meeting stated that 'the market overall has good allocation value' and outlined seven areas of work, including comprehensive measures to maintain market stability, increasing the scale and proportion of medium-to-long-term funds entering the market, and strengthening supervision of new business types.
